name: Check training transfer after a course
why: Compares real work after a course with the skills taught, the Level 3 behaviour check this kit asks for in every evaluation plan.

name: Build a practical manager training session
why: A timed manager session built around practice, with the behaviours to look for afterwards, matching the kit's practice-first design rule.

name: Write a procedure, test it and build a training deck
why: For clients with no SOP yet: write and test the procedure first, then train from it with the SOP to on-the-job training skill.

name: Training handout writer
why: A one-page handout with steps and common mistakes, the job aid every programme in this kit leaves behind.

name: New hire onboarding keeper
why: Plans a new hire's first 90 days and checks progress weekly, a companion to the onboarding learning path prompt.

name: Skill breakdown teaching planner
why: Breaks one skill into steps with a common mistake and self-check each, the same breakdown used for on-the-job demonstrations.

name: Practice session minute planner
why: Plans a practice session minute by minute with a coach card, useful for short floor sessions run by shift leads.

name: Build a volunteer induction checklist
why: An induction procedure with sign-offs and supervised practice, the same pattern as the kit's sign-off forms, for charities and volunteer teams.

name: Process doc freshness keeper
why: Finds stale or ownerless SOPs each month, so training is never built from an out-of-date procedure.

name: Survey answer truth checker
why: Checks how far a needs survey can be trusted before its numbers go into a training needs analysis.

name: Five whys session planner
why: A no-blame session plan for finding the cause of a failure, useful when deciding whether a problem is a training problem at all.
